scope: Small finite grounded calibration only: integer coordinates, singleton positive support \(t_c(p)=1\), sparse exact integer markings, identity transformations, each named candidate at most once. Every finite root generation is \(0\); tile generation is \(1\).

API.builder: build_cnf_model(variable_count, clauses, *, active_guards, seed_bits, maximum_candidates) -> frozen Model or BudgetExceeded/ValueError
API.solver: solve(model, *, maximum_nodes, maximum_candidate_checks, maximum_trace_events) -> JSON-compatible result
API.builder_input: variable_count is a nonnegative literal int. clauses is a tuple of clause tuples, each literal exactly (i,b) with literal integer index and bit in{0,1}; the literal is true iff assignment(i)=b. Variables are distinct in a clause. Empty clause() is allowed; empty CNF() is allowed. active_guards is the tuple of distinct activated clause indices; () is guard-unmarked, tuple(range(len(clauses))) all-active. seed_bits is a tuple of distinct(variable,bit) boundary pairs; () means no seeds. All outer/inner input containers are tuples; booleans are rejected in integer roles.
API.guard_mask: Guard-unmarked retains B/A consistency and flag markings. Mask changes only R_c marking entries; all B/A/R IDs and base supports remain. Guard q value enters current state only when R_c is placed. No live state/model mutation or replay of an old prefix API.
API.seed_boundary: Seed(i,b) initializes m(p_i)=b without preselecting B_i,b or assigning t at any point. Mark-only ports never become capacity obligations. Seeded model is a declared boundary-restricted problem, not a learned fact.

budgets.builder_candidate_limit: Required caller-supplied positive literal integer maximum_candidates. Precompute exact full count before generating; any overflow raises BudgetExceeded and no Model/prefix is returned. Root ceiling also checked before construction.
budgets.solver_counts: Required positive node/candidate-check/trace-event limits. Candidate checks charge validation, every original-candidate graph scan and selected full-solution recomposition. Trace event budget includes restore/finished events; exhausted trace revokes found/exhausted status. Root ceiling128 bounds recursive depth for this small calibration.
budgets.wall_memory_cancellation: No internal clock/rusage/cancellation API. Whole builder/model conversion/search/trace/result serialization plus actual external wall/memory/caller/cancellation costs must be charged by later ROOT invocation. No runtime/fit or inherited Q resource admission. External kill/incomplete result is UNKNOWN, never exhausted. This Source creates no actual plan/limits grant.

state_graph_scheduler.state: Frozen dataclasses containing immutable tuples only. No mutable totals/marks/generation/exclusion cache is shared; new local mark dict folded into a new frozen State. Parent State+complete parent Graph remains exact across recursive calls and is restored by persistent reference. Global stats/trace intentionally accumulate cost and are not rolled back.
state_graph_scheduler.graph: Full frontier includes every unfilled required root. One shared node per currently legal original candidate with t-positive incidence and reverse edge; all original candidate dependencies on base and every sparse marking point retained, including ports outside frontier. Full graph rebuilt for each new child state; no clause scan inside solver and no shortlist.
state_graph_scheduler.decision: Whole frontier degree0 first; otherwise singleton forced move; otherwise smallest generation then degree/point tie. Every child returns through a persistent restore. All current roots0 makes generation selection degenerate; does not qualify general growth scheduling.
state_graph_scheduler.trace: Complete graph/state/dependencies/generations decision snapshots; dead/forced/branch/place/restore/solution/finished events. UNKNOWN retains bounded prefix with trace_complete=false. Counters count rebuild/check/rejection reason/placement/forced/branch/backtrack/restore/max graph sizes and full-solution recompositions; rejection counts sum repeated scans, not unique candidate removals.

result_scope.FOUND: First internally whole t/m checked finite exact marked-model solution, complete trace through persistent root restoration. Not independent-oracle acceptance.
result_scope.EXHAUSTED_FINITE_MARKED_MODEL: Entire finite current candidate tree returned failure with complete trace within budgets. Only this exact boundary/guard-marked model; not an unmarked/theory nonexistence conclusion.
result_scope.UNKNOWN: Only BudgetExceeded produces this returned status; no candidate solution or exhausted prefix accepted. Invalid input ValueError and unexpected faults propagate; later ROOT harness must record infrastructure failures/incomplete output separately.

remaining_full_contract_gaps: No fractional t, partial deficits, candidate positive support shared across several points, nontrivial generation-growth model, newly exposed obligations, dynamic marking update/revalidation, symmetries/translations/reflections or infinite target.

No generic mutable graph/trail/refcount implementation: persistence provides exact rollback only in this immutable finite scope. No clusters/RL, learned clause synthesis/entailment or current Q engine/Source changes.

No runtime conformance/replay/independent exhaustive Boolean or point oracle results. Oracle authored separately and deliberately unread before this freeze. Future peer controls must check exact domains, degree0-vs-forced, seeds/assigned0/absence, empty clause, unit closure, successful/failed rollback, full solution/exhaustion and budget UNKNOWN.

No wall/memory/native/caller/fit/performance comparison. Marked versus guard-unmarked may define different solution sets; a redundant learned guard requires its own complete context certificate. No fixed Wang inventory, automatically discovered theorem or original-Q proof.
